title: Prototype return
passage:
Should I return the prototype today or tomorrow?
A. Yes, it is a prototype.
B. The return address is correct.
C. Tomorrow is fine; testing is not finished yet.
passageZh:
我該今天還是明天歸還樣機？
A. 是的，它是樣機。
B. 回郵地址是正確的。
C. 明天可以；測試還沒完成。
